title: Marguerite and the Ghost
author: Dominic Iversen
blurb: Emrys Whitlock, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
